pkg-001.title: Fly to Lukla, trek to Phakding
pkg-001.description: Scenic 35-minute mountain flight to Lukla (2,840 m), then an easy descent along the Dudh Koshi to Phakding.

pkg-001.title: Trek to Namche Bazaar
pkg-001.description: Cross the Dudh Koshi on high suspension bridges and climb steeply through pine forest to the Sherpa capital, Namche.

pkg-001.title: Acclimatisation day in Namche
pkg-001.description: Hike to the Everest View Hotel for a first sight of Everest, Lhotse and Ama Dablam, then rest in Namche.

pkg-001.title: Trek to Tengboche
pkg-001.description: Contour above the river with mountain views, drop to Phunki Thenga, then climb to the famous Tengboche Monastery.

pkg-001.title: Trek to Dingboche
pkg-001.description: Descend to Deboche, cross the Imja Khola and climb past Pangboche into the broad Imja Valley.

pkg-001.title: Acclimatisation day in Dingboche
pkg-001.description: Climb Nangkartshang ridge (5,080 m) for views of Makalu, then descend to sleep low.

pkg-001.title: Trek to Lobuche
pkg-001.description: Gentle valley walk to Thukla, a steep climb past the climbers' memorials, then along the Khumbu Glacier moraine.

pkg-001.title: Gorak Shep & Everest Base Camp
pkg-001.description: Trek to Gorak Shep, then out across the glacier to Everest Base Camp (5,364 m). Return to Gorak Shep for the night.

pkg-001.title: Kala Patthar sunrise, trek to Pheriche
pkg-001.description: Pre-dawn climb of Kala Patthar (5,545 m) for the classic Everest panorama, then a long descent to Pheriche.

pkg-001.title: Trek to Namche Bazaar
pkg-001.description: Retrace the trail through Tengboche and back down to Namche — noticeably easier with more oxygen.

pkg-001.title: Trek to Lukla
pkg-001.description: Final descent to the river and the last climb of the trek back up to Lukla. Celebration dinner with the crew.

pkg-001.title: Fly to Kathmandu
pkg-001.description: Morning flight back to Kathmandu (weather permitting). Afternoon at leisure.

pkg-001.title: Contingency / rest day in Kathmandu
pkg-001.description: Buffer day for flight delays. If not needed, explore Patan or Boudhanath.

pkg-001.title: Departure
pkg-001.description: Transfer to the airport for your onward flight.

pkg-1002.title: Fly to Lukla, trek to Monjo
pkg-1002.description: Mountain flight to Lukla, then a gentle trek down the Dudh Koshi valley to Monjo at the park gate.

pkg-1002.title: Trek to Namche Bazaar
pkg-1002.description: Enter Sagarmatha National Park and climb the long hill to Namche, with a first glimpse of Everest en route.

pkg-1002.title: Acclimatisation in Namche
pkg-1002.description: Short hike to Syangboche and the Everest View Hotel, then a relaxed afternoon exploring Namche's market.

pkg-1002.title: Trek to Tengboche
pkg-1002.description: The panoramic balcony trail to Tengboche Monastery, with Ama Dablam dominating the skyline.

pkg-1002.title: Explore Tengboche, trek to Khumjung
pkg-1002.description: Attend the morning puja at the monastery, then trek to the traditional Sherpa village of Khumjung.

pkg-1002.title: Trek to Monjo
pkg-1002.description: Descend past the Khumjung school and Everest View Hotel, rejoining the main trail down to Monjo.

pkg-1002.title: Trek to Lukla
pkg-1002.description: The final valley walk and the last uphill push back to Lukla. Farewell dinner with the crew.

pkg-1002.title: Fly to Kathmandu
pkg-1002.description: Return flight to Kathmandu. Rest of the day free.

pkg-1002.title: Departure
pkg-1002.description: Airport transfer for your onward journey.
